title: What a Pooled Leaderboard Does Not Say: Auditing the Scope and Provenance of Method Comparisons in Microservice RCA Benchmarks
abstract: arXiv:2606.29159v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Offline benchmarks for microservice root cause analysis (RCA) rank methods by a score pooled over several applications, and a pooled lead leaves two things unstated: on which of the systems it holds, and how the score was produced. We audit both on three public benchmark families (OpenRCA, RCAEval, and PetShop), running the released implementations of 16 methods under recorded configurations on 11 subsystems and on a second release of three of the applications. Whether a pooled lead between published methods holds on every subsystem is decided by a quantity the leaderboard withholds, the spread of the lead across subsystems: of 15 leads whose margin exceeds this spread, 14 hold everywhere; of the 8 whose margin is below it, 6 reverse. The per-fault and per-scenario tables that the benchmark papers publish split the same way, and every error of a ranking computed without one subsystem falls on a lead of the second kind. translated_title: 汇总排行榜没有说出的事：审计微服务根因分析基准测试中方法比较的范围与来源
translated_abstract: 微服务根因分析（RCA）的离线基准测试通过对多个应用汇总的分数来对方法进行排名，而这种汇总式领先存在两点未说明之处：该领先在哪些系统上成立，以及该分数是如何得出的。我们在三个公开基准测试族（OpenRCA、RCAEval 和 PetShop）上对这两点进行了审计，在记录在案的配置下运行了 16 个方法的官方发布实现，覆盖 11 个子系统，并在其中三个应用的第二个版本发布上进行了复测。已发表方法之间的汇总领先是否在每个子系统上都成立，取决于一个排行榜未披露的量——领先在各子系统间的波动幅度：在 15 个领先幅度超过该波动幅度的案例中，有 14 个在所有地方都成立；而在 8 个领先幅度低于该波动幅度的案例中，有 6 个发生了反转。基准测试论文所发表的按故障和按场景划分的表格也呈现出同样的划分方式，且去掉某个子系统后计算出的排名所出现的每一个错误，都恰好落在第二类领先上。
tldr: 该论文审计了微服务根因分析基准测试中的汇总排行榜，发现方法间的汇总领先只有在幅度超过其各子系统间的波动幅度时才可靠成立，否则排名极易在具体子系统或版本更新上发生反转。
en_tdlr: This paper audits pooled leaderboards in microservice RCA benchmarks, showing that a method's pooled lead reliably holds across all subsystems only when its margin exceeds its spread across subsystems, while leads below this threshold are highly likely to reverse under finer-grained evaluation or software updates.
